name: Almanac

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm, uncoated. In Night the ink becomes the ground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, tickets, dialogs: a lighter sheet on the paper.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The hero band and arch panels: a deeper warm ground that holds one big thing.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: The soft green ground inside a device or a figure.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines at a quarter strength. The only border in the system.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Forest green: all text, all rules, the first series.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text at 65%: captions, notes, metadata.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta: the one word in a headline, the filled button, the progress bar, the second series.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for accent tags and the selected state.

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: The third series and nothing else.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and the kept share, with a word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success callouts and positive tags.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings as text: an ochre on paper.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors share the terracotta; there is no second red.

principles: Text, rules, figures, the first series: all forest green. Colour never carries meaning the ink could carry.
The accent lands on the emphasised word in a headline, the filled button, the second series. Twice on a view is once too many.
Separation is a 1px rule at a quarter strength above a block. Cards are rare and cast a soft terracotta shadow when they exist.
Outcome numbers are set in the serif at -.07em, one per block, with the sentence under them. They are read, not scanned.
A panel with a rounded top holds one object: a device, a figure, a number. Everything else stays on the paper.
